_comment: Example config for payment_handler (RESERVED MODULE — built but not deployed for any client yet). Copy to clients/<name>/payment_handler.json and edit. vision_callable + whatsapp_sender are Python callables — inject at init time, NOT via JSON.
_vision_prompt_note: Override only if you need a different extraction schema. Default asks Claude to return {amount, reference, bank, sender, date, recipient} as JSON.
_templates_note: Override per stage per language if you want different wording. Stages: submitted | approved | rejected | duplicate. Placeholders: {business_name} {manager_name} {manager_phone} {reference} {amount} {reason}.
